# Inputs, categories, transfer, Focus (2026-11-21)

## Inputs that didn't work
- **Quick add**: the field wasn't single-line, so the keyboard's ✓ added a new line instead of saving — nothing got added. Now single-line; ✓ (or the send button) **adds the task and closes the drawer**. Verified on the phone: Today went 6 → 7 to go.
- **Money sheet**: the Save button sat under the keyboard. The drawer now scrolls with the keyboard (`imePadding`), the keyboard's ✓ on the last field saves, and the button says what's missing ("Enter an amount", "Pick a category"). Verified: ₹450 Food #work saved, Spent +₹450, drawer closed.
- **New list**: keyboard ✓ creates the list.

## Priority in quick add
A small flag **inside the input** opens a compact Expressive menu (High / Medium / Low / No priority, flag colors). `!high` etc. still work.

## Categories as chips + your own
Categories are selectable **filter chips** with the category's shape, icon and color; tap again to clear. **New category** opens a drawer: name (e.g. "Food & drinks", "Casual"), one of 22 icons, one of 7 colors; it's selected right away and stays as a chip. Expense needs a category; income doesn't.

## Accounts and transfer
Accounts are a clean field that opens an Expressive grouped menu (icon, name). Transfer is **From** card, swap button, **To** card — no more rows of chips.

## Focus
- **Timer drawer**: presets as a connected group (Short 15·3, Pomodoro 25·5, Deep 50·10) plus **sliders for any custom timing**: focus 5–120 min, break 1–30 min, sessions 1–8.
- **Tap the clock while paused or reset** to open it. A new timing restarts the paused phase with the new length.
- **Three clock views** (connected group under the clock, remembered): **Ring** (turning Cookie12 + wavy ring), **Liquid** (the Cookie12 fills up with a drifting wave), **Minimal** (huge rounded digits + wavy line).
